| |
**Jennifer-Ruth Green Announces Campaign for Congress: “Ready to Finish the Mission”**
---
| | CROWN POINT, IN – Today, Jennifer-Ruth Green, a conservative Republican, Air Force veteran, Lieutenant Colonel in the Air National Guard, and former Republican congressional nominee, officially announced her candidacy for Congress in Indiana’s First Congressional District to support President Trump and advance an agenda focused on a stronger middle class, stronger families, and a stronger America:
_“I have spent my life serving our country and striving to serve others. I love this country, and I am still called to serve. Today, I am announcing my candidacy for Congress because Northwest Indiana deserves better,”_**Green said.**_**** “The stakes have never been higher. When we defeat far-left Congressman Frank Mrvan and take back Indiana’s First District for the first time since 1928, Republicans will keep the House, and we’ll stop Mrvan and his radical allies in Congress from impeaching President Trump and advancing their socialist agenda.” _

---
[|
---](https://jennifer-ruthgreen.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4d4f3d49ab2e7b9f51a795964&id=bfe3ca884a&e=9fba06d14c)
| | [Watch Jennifer-Ruth’s Announcement Video](https://jennifer-ruthgreen.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4d4f3d49ab2e7b9f51a795964&id=d1b944002f&e=9fba06d14c)
_“This isn’t about politics—it’s about saving America,”_ **Green said**. _“I serve our country in uniform. Now I’m ready to fight for the America we love in Congress.”_
A graduate of the U.S. Air Force Academy, Green served as a counterintelligence mission commander in Baghdad, where she worked to keep America safe. She now serves as a Lieutenant Colonel in the Air National Guard. Green founded a nonprofit that helps at-risk youth through aerospace and leadership training. As Indiana’s first Secretary of Public Safety, Green supported first responders across the state and worked with the Trump administration to remove dangerous illegal immigrants from local communities.
In Congress, Green pledges to stand “shoulder to shoulder” with President Trump to:
* Rebuild American manufacturing and create middle-class jobs
* Fight for bigger paychecks and lower prices
* Support farmers and rural communities
* Secure the border and deport violent illegal immigrants
* Defend life, the Second Amendment, and law enforcement

Jennifer-Ruth Green came closer to winning IN-01 in 2022 than any Republican has since from 1928 to present. It continues to trend our way — with President Trump following just a half a point short in the district in 2024. With Indiana likely to redistrict to make this seat fairer and more competitive, IN-01 will be key to the control of the House of Representatives in 2026 and at the forefront of efforts to combat Democrats’ outrageous gerrymanders and 2021 decision to count millions of illegal immigrants in the Census – skewing congressional apportionment to their advantage and diluting the representation of tens of millions of American citizens in deep red states like Indiana.
For more information, visit [www.JenniferRuthGreen.com](https://jennifer-ruthgreen.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4d4f3d49ab2e7b9f51a795964&id=176a3a5753&e=9fba06d14c).

#

_Let me lay this out, clear as day:_
I am the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won in 2024.
And this Senate race in Georgia will be the most competitive and most expensive in the nation.
If you’re outraged by what’s happening to our country — and you’re ready to fight –– please rush $5 to my reelection campaign today.
**Here’s the link to donate:**[**https://act.electjon.com/go/donate**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-oct25.ZBiurg&refcode=em251028-1-f&t=1&akid=985%2E5691347%2ENpebr7)
Otherwise, let me remind you why I ran for Senate — and why this moment is just as urgent.
Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution.
More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminded me of those places where dissent was silenced by intimidation.
Trump’s rise wasn’t just a crisis. It was a warning.
I ran for Senate because I saw the danger in electing someone so profoundly unfit for the presidency and I wanted to confront the corruption that made his rise possible.
I also ran — years before the Dobbs decision — because it was already clear the GOP was coming for reproductive rights. I saw Georgia as the front line in that fight. With a six-week ban now in place here, and Republicans pushing for a national abortion ban, it still is.
**Now this President is staging a power grab unprecedented in our history:**
* He’s freed violent criminals who attacked the Capitol on his behalf.
* Purged independent watchdogs across government.
* Stacked key agencies with loyalists — and called on them to investigate his political opponents.
* Defied and threatened federal judges.
* Undermined the press.

body:
THE GARAND

Introducing The Garand — a limited-release salute to American grit and battlefield glory from Patriot Cigar Company.

Hand-rolled in a commanding 7.5 x 48 Churchill, The Garand stands tall like the legendary rifle it’s named after — a symbol of strength, precision, and American might. Expertly crafted with 7-year aged Nicaraguan tobacco and finished in a rich Habano wrapper, this cigar delivers a smooth, medium-strength profile that fires off bold flavor with every draw — steady, confident, and unmistakably patriotic.

AVAILABLE IN 5 PACKS ONLY!
https://mypatriotcigars.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3ea77f33fc36dd7515163e71c&id=00c6d6d539&e=fbf55fa623

This is a STRICTLY limited release.
When The Garand is gone — it’s gone. No restock. No second run.

Lock, load, and light up history.

About The Garand

The Garand from Patriot Cigar Company is more than a premium hand-rolled cigar — it is a cigar built in tribute to the rifle that helped secure victory for freedom across the world: the M1 Garand, the rifle General George S. Patton famously called “the greatest battle implement ever devised.”

A commanding 7.5 x 48 Churchill, The Garand is rolled with precision and reverence, echoing the engineering excellence of its namesake. Packed with 7-year aged Nicaraguan filler and binder, and clad in a beautifully finished Habano wrapper, this cigar offers a confidently smooth medium-strength profile — a slow-burning, dignified smoke with depth, refinement, and authority. It is rich without being overpowering, balanced yet bold, a cigar built for those who honor legacy as much as flavor.
------------------------------------------------------------

** A Tribute to a Legend
------------------------------------------------------------

Adopted by the U.S. military in 1936 and carried proudly through World War II and the Korean War, the M1 Garand was the first standard-issue semi-automatic battle rifle in the world — a game-changer in combat. Where other nations’ soldiers still chambered rounds by hand, American troops were able to fire shot after shot with speed and reliability. It was rugged. It was accurate. It was trusted in the mud, the snow, the jungles, and the beaches of Normandy. It represented innovation, confidence, and overwhelming American firepower.

The M1 Garand wasn’t just a rifle — it was a handheld symbol of American dominance and ingenuity, a lifeline to soldiers whose courage reshaped history.
------------------------------------------------------------

** The Cigar Worthy of the Name
------------------------------------------------------------

The spirit of that legendary rifle lives in this limited-edition release:
* 7.5 x 48 Churchill — a proud, commanding presence
* 7-year aged Nicaraguan tobacco — matured for depth and character
* Habano wrapper — warm, rich, and worthy of a namesake of warfighters
* Medium strength — a long, thoughtful smoke that marches forward with confidence

This cigar is meant to be enjoyed the way history is remembered — deliberately, with pride, and without rush.
------------------------------------------------------------

** A One-Time Tribute
------------------------------------------------------------

Like the heroes who carried the M1 across the world, The Garand will not be mass-produced or remade. This is a strictly limited release — when this cigar is gone, it’s gone. No second run. No encore.

Light one in honor of the warriors who stood between tyranny and liberty — and for the enduring American spirit that still refuses to yield.

The Garand
A rifle that won wars.
A cigar that honors the warrior.

AVAILABLE IN 5 PACKS ONLY
USE PROMO CODE
FOR 20% OFF CIGARS

The Patriot Pack — Smoke for the Bold and the Free

Stand tall and light up freedom with The Patriot Pack from Patriot Cigar Company — a powerful lineup built for true American patriots. Featuring The “Pledge” Premium Leather 3-Cigar Travel Case, the Old Glory Cigar Cutter, and three powerhouse blends — TNT, MOAB, and Sidewinder — this set is your all-American arsenal of premium, hand-rolled cigars. **
------------------------------------------------------------

** The Patriot Pack
A Bold Salute to Liberty
------------------------------------------------------------

Raise your colors high — the Patriot Pack from Patriot Cigar Company is the ultimate tribute to freedom, made for those who stand proud. This isn’t just a cigar set; it’s a declaration, a statement, and a smoke-filled salute to the red, white, and blue.

** Included Inside the Patriot Pack
------------------------------------------------------------

**
“The Pledge” Premium Leather 3-Cigar Travel Case
------------------------------------------------------------

Carry your cigars in patriotic style. This rugged yet elegant case is crafted in premium printed leather with the pledge of allegiance, built to safeguard your Patriot Cigars while projecting staunch American pride. Designed for travel, with room for three cigars up to a 60-ring size and a secure closure, it’s more than storage—it’s armor for your freedom smoke.

** Old Glory Cigar Cutter
------------------------------------------------------------

No patriot’s toolkit is complete without a sharp edge. The Old Glory Cigar Cutter is a dual-blade instrument worthy of the name. It slices clean and precise, honoring the flag with every snip (and making sure your draw is perfect).
------------------------------------------------------------

** The Finest Blends Under the Flag
------------------------------------------------------------

** TNT
------------------------------------------------------------

Explosive in flavor and bold in character, TNT is a powerhouse medium to full blend that commands your attention. From first light to the last ember, it burns with authority.

** MOAB (Mother of All Bombs)
------------------------------------------------------------

MOAB delivers a full-bodied punch, a maduro cigar that lives up to its name. Deep, rich, and intense — this is not for the faint of heart but for the true patriot who demands maximum firepower in flavor.

** Sidewinder
------------------------------------------------------------

Sleek, swift, and sly — the Sidewinder rounds out the pack with a medium blend that strikes with finesse. Balanced, bold, and full of character, it’s the curveball every patriotic smoker needs.

The Patriot Pack doesn’t stop there, you’ll also get a Patriot-branded beverage koozie, coaster, sticker, and patch—because every smoke session deserves a touch of American pride.
------------------------------------------------------------

** Why the Patriot Pack Matters
------------------------------------------------------------

This is not merely a sampler or gift set. The Patriot Pack is your on-demand arsenal of American spirit and premium craftsmanship. It’s a perfect companion for travel, a striking gift for fellow flag-bearers, or your own daily reminder that freedom is worth celebrating — one premium puff at a time.

Light up The Patriot Pack. Puff with pride. And let the smoke carry your pledge to liberty.

** Uncompromising Quality, Made for Patriots
------------------------------------------------------------

At Patriot Cigar Company, every cigar is handcrafted in Estelí, Nicaragua, using premium-aged tobacco (aged a minimum of three years). Our blends were born from the desire to bring together the love of premium smokes and the love of our country, forging a brand built on passion and pride.

8 CIGAR SAMPLER PACK

Peter,

My name is Winsome Earle-Sears, and if you don't mind, I'd like to tell you a little about myself. **I 'm not your typical politician, and I never will be. _This is my story._**

In 2021, I won the General Election for Lieutenant Governor of Virginia by less than 60,000 votes. In doing so, I became the first black woman to hold this office--but that's not why I ran. I ran to effect real change and instill common-sense conservative leadership. That's exactly what we have done and will continue to do.

Hi Peter,
My name is Cate Paterson, and I just started as Finance Director for Governor Tim Walz’s reelection campaign! I wanted to introduce myself and let you know why I’m so excited to be on Team Walz.
I’ve worked on gubernatorial races across the country including helping elect Governor Josh Stein in North Carolina and Governor Andy Beshear in Kentucky.

Peter,
When Trump is on the ballot Republican candidates typically perform better because of his ability to turnout GOP voters who don't typically vote.
This effect is called the Trump bump.
In 2024, GOP Congressional candidates coasted off of the Trump bump to take back the House. However, there was one candidate who didn't receive it -- in fact, she got whatever the opposite of the Trump bump is, let's call it the Trump dump.
Lauren Boebert.
Boebert underperformed Trump in every county and had the worst performance a Republican has ever had in this district while her Democratic opponent, Trisha Calvarese, a labor leader and actual resident of the district unlike Boebert, had the best performance a Democrat has ever had here.
Trump isn't on the ballot in 2026 meaning less GOP voters will show up and Boebert won't even get the Trump dump. She is only in Congress because of 546 votes and is already incredibly vulnerable because of her scandals, her voters see her as a carpet bagger, and her campaign is nearly out of money -- last quarter we outraised her 5-1.

However, there was one candidate who didn’t receive it. | | | | | == | Peter, When Trump is on the ballot Republican candidates typically perform better because of his ability to turnout GOP voters who don't typically vote. This effect is called the Trump bump. In 2024, GOP Congressional candidates coasted off of the Trump bump to take back the House. However, there was one candidate who didn't receive it -- in fact, she got whatever the opposite of the Trump bump is, let's call it the Trump dump. Lauren Boebert. Boebert underperformed Trump in every county and had the worst performance a Republican has ever had in this district while her Democratic opponent, Trisha Calvarese, a labor leader and actual resident of the district unlike Boebert, had the best performance a Democrat has ever had here. Trump isn't on the ballot in 2026 meaning less GOP voters will show up and Boebert won't even get the Trump dump. She is only in Congress because of 546 votes and is already incredibly vulnerable because of her scandals, her voters see her as a carpet bagger, and her campaign is nearly out of money -- last quarter we outraised her 5-1. subject: Hearing aids just got their biggest upgrade
body:
Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts

| [](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zjphslpiih70creets2o6867v9b7c1ce23r7fc0o_rp22sh2s8i6eor4cdjmep34c1h2bs)
---
| Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts
---
[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zl8ajc3d6l9stau33orf04l2utroapmrv98plds0_rp22sh2s8i6eor4cdjmep34c1h2bs)
**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's [hear.com's](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z2r2uej9f9ktq9d9m7dkn5f7oujj1ljr9hs19dco_rp22sh2s8i6eor4cdjmep34c1h2bs) **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **[hear.com's](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z271d16k26odh6ag2t2c8kdbqducvcvcjrdolmog_rp22sh2s8i6eor4cdjmep34c1h2bs) IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2za4os9b20rvkgb6e149cgn4j7mkm7ogcd42d4sko_rp22sh2s8i6eor4cdjmep34c1h2bs)
[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z7qa44a29g30tor7a5jtscsb7e9c2kem1h59il1o_rp22sh2s8i6eor4cdjmep34c1h2bs)
What makes [hear.com's](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zliqe3du1foae936o9vat6ckobaj8p2fe2i8f4mg_rp22sh2s8i6eor4cdjmep34c1h2bs) IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that [hear.com's](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zn306uj6qnfhfrk6q2indms77unsundi3tpv6nt0_rp22sh2s8i6eor4cdjmep34c1h2bs) IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains [hear.com's](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2za0ss8icr1dr55g4bob8e6ch9daeusm7717f9998_rp22sh2s8i6eor4cdjmep34c1h2bs) founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

Limited no-risk trials now available

Click below to check if you qualify for a 45-day no-risk trial. As the Germans always say: "there's never been a better time." So do yourself a favor and don’t wait. **Get started today.**
[Check if you qualify](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zserj0n4of9mkjjgba019rlhupfmd1b11nllu1cg_rp22sh2s8i6eor4cdjmep34c1h2bs)

**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's hear.com's **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **hear.com's IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zikibik5mmtn2b2s1n7b6i2sfdf6v2k93ihh62a0_rp22sh2s8i6eor4cdjm1o32c1h2bs)

What makes hear.com’s IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that hear.com’s IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains hear.com founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

Friends — Give us just a minute to explain our situation.
**The good news:** Despite the government shutdown, this amazing grassroots team has helped us stay afloat and continue to afford to invest in a winning campaign. We’re grateful for everyone who has chipped in so far this month.
**The bad news:** We are now three days away from our October fundraising deadline, and we’re still way behind where we hoped we’d be at this point. We’re now in real danger of missing our goals.
Team, these goals are not arbitrary. We don’t take asking for your donation lightly.
The truth is that at any moment this race can change drastically. We’ve heard rumors about AIPAC looking for someone to challenge Ilhan. We’ve seen reports of well-funded challengers considering jumping into this race, and polls being run in our district.
The day those reports and rumors become reality, we will instantly be behind. That’s not an exaggeration.
AIPAC spent over **$100 million** in last year’s elections, a record-breaking amount of money in American politics. Most of that was spent to defeat progressive candidates in their primaries.
If AIPAC takes the leap to get into this race, or any other powerful corporate PAC, we better believe they will spend millions and millions on attack ads and smear campaigns against Ilhan. **We have to be ready.**

**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's hear.com's **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **hear.com's IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.

What makes hear.com’s IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that hear.com’s IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains hear.com founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

---
Fellow Conservative,

Picture 2002. You were renting movies at Blockbuster, maybe flipping open that new Motorola phone to call a buddy. CSI was must-watch TV, and the first iPods were hitting the shelves, promising a thousand songs in your pocket. That was the last time a Republican won a full Senate term in Minnesota. Twenty-three years. For over two decades, Democrats have treated this state like their personal fiefdom—silencing conservative voices, pushing radical policies, and turning our Minnesota values into a punching bag for their far-left agenda.

Enough is enough. It’s time to take our state - and our country – back.

I’m Adam Schwarze, born and raised in the Twin Cities—St. Paul kid, Bloomington hockey player, and a former Navy SEAL and Marine Corps veteran. **I enlisted on my 18th birthday, weeks after 9/11, because America called, and I answered. Nine deployments, 70 countries, leading SEAL teams through Iraq’s battlefields, commanding covert ops across the Pacific and Middle East, earning valor awards and early promotions—I’ve served with everything I’ve got. Now, I’m home, and what I see in Minnesota breaks my heart: skyrocketing prices crushing retirees, open borders flooding our communities with drugs and crime, and Tim Walz’s handpicked lieutenant governor, Peggy Flanagan, my opponent, ready to double down on the chaos.**

Peggy Flanagan? clean_body: Democrats have treated Minnesota like their personal fiefdom - but with your help, we can put those days behind us. | Fellow Conservative, Picture 2002. You were renting movies at Blockbuster, maybe flipping open that new Motorola phone to call a buddy. CSI was must-watch TV, and the first iPods were hitting the shelves, promising a thousand songs in your pocket. That was the last time a Republican won a full Senate term in Minnesota. Twenty-three years. For over two decades, Democrats have treated this state like their personal fiefdom—silencing conservative voices, pushing radical policies, and turning our Minnesota values into a punching bag for their far-left agenda. Enough is enough. It’s time to take our state - and our country – back. I’m Adam Schwarze, born and raised in the Twin Cities—St. Paul kid, Bloomington hockey player, and a former Navy SEAL and Marine Corps veteran. I enlisted on my 18th birthday, weeks after 9/11, because America called, and I answered. Nine deployments, 70 countries, leading SEAL teams through Iraq’s battlefields, commanding covert ops across the Pacific and Middle East, earning valor awards and early promotions—I’ve served with everything I’ve got. Now, I’m home, and what I see in Minnesota breaks my heart: skyrocketing prices crushing retirees, open borders flooding our communities with drugs and crime, and Tim Walz’s handpicked lieutenant governor, Peggy Flanagan, my opponent, ready to double down on the chaos. Peggy Flanagan? She’s Walz’s shadow: suing Minneapolis police while riots burned our cities in 2020, blaming law-and-order folks for her party’s failures, and now eyeing an open Minnesota Senate seat to push more tax hikes, fan the flame of culture wars not yet started, and spearhead policies that put illegals ahead of hardworking Minnesotans. Under their watch, crime spiked. Walz talks “Minnesota nice,” but his budget cuts and fiscal flops have left our veterans ignored, our police underfunded, and our neighborhoods less safe. Here’s the spark: Recent polls from their own side show a generic Republican trailing by just two points. With United States Senator Tina Smith retiring, this seat is open for the first time in decades. Minnesota hasn’t gone red in a presidential race since Nixon in ’72, but the tide’s turning—Trump’s legacy is firing up folks like you, retired patriots who’ve built lives on hard work and faith. We can flip this seat, secure the Republican Senate majority, and give President Trump the muscle to drain the swamp for good. I’m running to cut taxes, back our police, secure the border, and defend the values you’ve spent your life upholding—family, faith, and freedom. We’re the underdogs, no question. Minnesota’s been blue since the days of dial-up internet. But I’ve led missions through worse odds—high-stakes ops where one mistake meant everything. Our last fundraising push got us halfway to our goal, but with Q4 filings looming and Flanagan raking in cash from coastal elites, You—retired vets, churchgoers, grandparents who’ve paid your dues—can fuel the ads, the door-knockers, the momentum to shock the system. You’ve got a choice. Delete this and let Democrats keep choking our future. Or stand with a battle-hardened SEAL ready to fight—not with noise, but with the quiet professionalism that wins wars. Help me make it real. Because we built this country on sacrifice and resolve, and we’re not done fighting. For a better tomorrow, Adam Schwarze Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate Former Navy SEAL officer Marine Corps Veteran Proud Minnesotan FOLLOW ADAM ON SOCIAL MEDIA | | Paid for by Schwarze for Senate Adam Schwarze is a former Navy SEAL and Marine. Friend, I want to tell you about my friend Garlin Gilchrist. Garlin and I were both born and raised in Detroit. We were both raised by a parent who worked in the auto industry, and we saw from an early age how good union jobs allow working people to provide a better life for their families. When Garlin ran for Lieutenant Governor in 2018, I was running in my first race for Congress. **Here we are knocking on doors together in 2018:** [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsXu0R1XDWRVJnEMC9_ePsJ3ubmsxi1dfP0RLvXPjk9SzPT6EM9RMWjtT6TEbbzyvWubDUeTKvF6iaiv6MdVZWgpHcxAjvcMTY9aes6QOHDeQisP_fE9rW78dyI2qFvZgsgjkqmyhBXjI0bZyeV4fYNSPZ4i2dritdLKddV3vjUnu98C8t_YFbnQUWw_OKCkXr5PFk7rDqyZrIIp5tU9uVBmmRc4lnxHOLXQmK7VIsahZkggZ2USMVpksWy11GOMn4MMkxmlmFUO32ITcJEsze8tvh0rBvE7FMZo0djUakNMbGaAdj4ue0lsAuMWjoDxklxNK9y8g66_xIWjq5c7PrbjJc_BVd_gx7OsFBC7iS3fuW7HeYAL0mMc88oOfhE7LB8n-vrTLhxfUSVoWh8amPEPWdz1lN27C2tcdjVD8VypQ/4l4/kmlGbhq0R4OYcOrkG29gDA/h1/h001.wmIwqijnbJd7SZTGS_7Y94k8dGQ4k6i2f678UJ3gJiA) In 2020, early in the pandemic, I teamed up with Garlin to deliver critical COVID-19 updates to our communities through virtual town halls. And he’s never forgotten his roots. **Like me, he stands up to corporate greed in our shared struggle for an economy that puts everyday people first.** As our Lieutenant Governor, Garlin has worked to expand affordable housing and improve access to healthcare and mental health services. Now, Garlin is running to be the next Governor of the State of Michigan. He’s the only Democrat in the race who is willing to call out the toxic influence of billionaire money, AIPAC money, and corporate money in our politics. [**I am proud to endorse my friend, Lieutenant Governor Garlin Gilchrist, for Governor. After earning two engineering degrees and working as a software engineer, Garlin came home to serve his community. He’s played a leading role in delivering free Pre-K for all, increasing the success of small businesses, protecting abortion access, bringing more high-quality jobs to our state, and reforming our justice system. He’s also connected tens of thousands of Michiganders to reliable, affordable, high speed internet.
Garlin knows what it’s like to be from a community that has been forgotten and left behind. I know he’ll fight for the people over corporate greed, and unlike billionaires Elon Musk and Donald Trump, he knows how to use technology and innovation to help all of our communities thrive.
[**Join me in supporting my friend and colleague Garlin Gilchrist for Governor. clean_body: Garlin knows what it’s like to be from a community that has been forgotten and left behind. | | | Friend, I want to tell you about my friend Garlin Gilchrist. Garlin and I were both born and raised in Detroit. We were both raised by a parent who worked in the auto industry, and we saw from an early age how good union jobs allow working people to provide a better life for their families. When Garlin ran for Lieutenant Governor in 2018, I was running in my first race for Congress. Here we are knocking on doors together in 2018: In 2020, early in the pandemic, I teamed up with Garlin to deliver critical COVID-19 updates to our communities through virtual town halls. Later that year, we partnered with one another to encourage Michiganders to take advantage of early and absentee voting. Here we are getting out the vote in 2020: When auto workers at Ford, GM, and Stellantis went on strike, we stood with union workers in their fight for a fair contract. Here we are with UAW President Shawn Fain in September 2023 , the month before UAW workers won a new union contract: Today, Garlin is the highest-ranking Black elected official in Michigan history. And he’s never forgotten his roots. Like me, he stands up to corporate greed in our shared struggle for an economy that puts everyday people first. As our Lieutenant Governor, Garlin has worked to expand affordable housing and improve access to healthcare and mental health services. Now, Garlin is running to be the next Governor of the State of Michigan. He’s the only Democrat in the race who is willing to call out the toxic influence of billionaire money, AIPAC money, and corporate money in our politics. | After earning two engineering degrees and working as a software engineer, Garlin came home to serve his community. He’s played a leading role in delivering free Pre-K for all, increasing the success of small businesses, protecting abortion access, bringing more high-quality jobs to our state, and reforming our justice system. He’s also connected tens of thousands of Michiganders to reliable, affordable, high speed internet. Garlin knows what it’s like to be from a community that has been forgotten and left behind. I know he’ll fight for the people over corporate greed, and unlike billionaires Elon Musk and Donald Trump, he knows how to use technology and innovation to help all of our communities thrive. **Christine Flowers** is a lifelong Philadelphian, who has a deep attachment to the region. She has been practicing immigration law for over twenty-five years with a specialization in asylum and refugee law, after having taught high school French and Spanish at area schools. In addition to her legal practice, Christine is a syndicated columnist whose opinion pieces appear in newspapers across the country, as well as a regular participant in local radio and television programs that focus on current affairs.

A graduate of Merion Mercy Academy, Bryn Mawr College and Villanova Law School, her local roots run deep. This can best be expressed by the fact that her mood is directly related to how well the Eagles, Flyers, Sixers and Phillies are playing at any given moment. Christine is an aunt to one human, two Black Labs and a bearded dragon.

subject: Op-Ed: A choice for Americans tired of political gridlock

body:
Here's what's happening in the Forward world...

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_83a&n=1)
---
Tuesday, October 28, 2025 | Peter -- Most Americans know something’s broken. Toxic partisanship, closed primaries, and gerrymandered districts have left voters frustrated and powerless -- watching yet another government shutdown while politicians play the same old game. The truth is, the system is designed to protect the two major parties, not the people they’re supposed to serve. In an [op-ed](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=QbF-A43IZlAkjFqaumBqPYIBIbgNDmM_ZH3tovHEyzserIMFdCed5D5k6Lwx_M-DDV2CU3qI22SjF5F3iRVgj9jBD-qI4S1wJqkQwpBAJaBzDov9PMXMPiojvAve114q&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_83a&n=2) in Saturday's Boston Globe, Forward Party CEO Lindsey Drath lays out how we fix it. In her powerful and inspiring piece, she explains how the nation needs an alternative party now more than ever and how Forward is building a real alternative; one rooted in accountability, collaboration, and common sense, and not a spoiler party. Lindsey also makes the case for Forward as a movement to replace dysfunction with problem-solvers and give every voter a true choice. She demonstrates how Forward's fulcrum strategy in Congress can put an end to the type of partisan gridlock that has led to this extended shutdown. It is a great thought piece on "Why Forward and Why Now." The op-ed is behind a paywall, but the full text is pasted below. **OPINION: A choice for Americans tired of political gridlock** **We’re not just offering an alternative party. We’re working for a better system.** By Lindsey Williams Drath The current structures of America’s political system encourage toxic polarization, extreme policy positions, and blatant self-interest. No wonder we find ourselves in the midst of a government shutdown. All the while, the majority of voters yearn for good government and true representation. Americans are deeply dissatisfied with our politics. [More than half the respondents](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=gkLifXhhNOE3Yo38Mrn-yRtFFwlPvnN7SiPIIMeJCJdJOH4Qw6zFpD_XcqJtyD02ugJfLsdeH6dbNNSBbuNHayJYj5GjjfocffiwRuwM8mCdTu7kuxJT3e1_eDuOKez_1b8v9LKSPVHwxTcVqQWJ0xSut04mLJGFD85PyJ8jovE0R2bODuL4Tsvu9iXSQm72rX5O5qs9nF4N9km6X517sA&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_83a&n=3) in a recent poll believe we are in a constitutional crisis, only half believe our government is a democracy, and more than [60 percent favor a viable third-party alternative](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=cCJNx_i1q-s1JjGee0i8m7_gNW8Blw2hOZAPKQ8hxS2a08sRBbJTghEYFmQO0jV7ZrUvpaNqkNT57KakjGqbW8EpM38zfV3QJEMZhOjR8RCXW8rxiD-g2w2MhvbYdekb&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_83a&n=4) _._ While congressional approval sits at roughly [26 percent,](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=cCJNx_i1q-s1JjGee0i8mxdMCGYwV8-Al4AznP18EjVSFSPOwMyH7g1I3ClE-4YF9W0a9zGY4yr10-6f5zQrzg&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_83a&n=5) most individual members are reelected at a staggering rate of more than [96 percent](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=4rXsFN8lsgBHDPbt6_ZGdrU6G0cy5laybKrKTFXO6-aIyDgFCN3YowLB5ALK0qgCxSIzBdvI1VbDLhhIYP4Scrx0mN9KoA0tTrw_GFUUKUk&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_83a&n=6) _._ The dissatisfied majority is vastly underrepresented by current elected leaders. Independents now consistently outnumber registered Republicans or Democrats nationally. Meanwhile, the two major parties dominate redistricting measures and control election rules that effectively lock out alternatives. This is why the Forward Party was founded: By giving Americans disappointed with the status quo a real choice, we can populate town halls, state capitols, and Congress with principled lawmakers committed to country over party and solutions over partisan gridlock. What would the halls of the Capitol have looked like last month if a dozen members of Congress elected outside of the two-party system had held out their votes until Republicans and Democrats came together and compromised to explore an extension of the Affordable Care Act tax subsidies? This is an issue that 77 percent of Americans can agree on, and yet that did not happen. | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/donate?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_83a&n=7 "CHIP IN TO HELP ELECT MORE INDEPENDENTS") [CHIP IN TO HELP ELECT MORE INDEPENDENTS](https://home.forwardparty.com/donate?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_83a&n=7)
---
There are about 520,000 elected offices in the United States. In 2024, 70 percent of races examined by Ballotpedia ran uncontested. Combine that with the fact that only 69 out of 435 US House seats are competitive, with 85 percent of seats decidedly red or blue, and we see a map of America with little real political competition.
The current structures of America’s political system encourage toxic polarization, extreme policy positions, and blatant self-interest. No wonder we find ourselves in the midst of a government shutdown. All the while, the majority of voters yearn for good government and true representation.
Americans are deeply dissatisfied with our politics. More than half the respondents in a recent poll believe we are in a constitutional crisis, only half believe our government is a democracy, and more than 60 percent favor a viable third-party alternative. While congressional approval sits at roughly 26 percent, most individual members are reelected at a staggering rate of more than 96 percent.
In uncompetitive congressional districts, the party not in power has all but given up, leaving voters no choice at the ballot box. Beyond congressional districts, entire states have been deemed blue or red. The Democratic Party isn’t investing in serious competition in red-state Utah, and the Republican Party isn’t investing in serious competition in blue-state Massachusetts.
Yet in Massachusetts, 65 percent of voters are registered as unaffiliated or with third parties. Of the nine congressional districts in Massachusetts, only two districts had a Republican on the ballot running against the Democratic candidate last November. This is where the Forward Party comes in: to give voters a choice.
The Forward Party is committed to running values-based, solution-oriented candidates for all offices at the state and local level, as we build the infrastructure needed to stand up viable campaigns for federal office.
We will build a big tent by leading with shared values like accountability, transparency, and commitment to the rule of law instead of rigid ideology. We welcome disaffected Democrats, Republicans, and independents who are tired of toxic partisanship and lack of policy solutions. We are building from the ground up, starting with local races and community leadership rather than national personalities.
We will foster civil discourse and respectful disagreement to reach consensus on how to solve challenges affecting Americans like affordability, the rise of AI, physical and mental health challenges, immigration, crime and safety, and educating our children for a changing world. These core issues can unite diverse voters around practical solutions. We will leverage technology to drive grass-roots organizing, participatory policy-making, and transparency. We will seek to reframe political language, talking about problem-solvers and community-first governance instead of left vs. right or us vs. them.
Over the past 30 years, there have been multiple attempts to introduce competition into the political process. However, they have all been in races for president, including Ross Perot, Mike Bloomberg, and the No Labels Unity Ticket. With hundreds of thousands of elected offices across the country, voters have the opportunity to introduce competition into the political process from the ground up. Additionally, in a gridlocked Congress, a new political party can be the most powerful voting bloc with fewer than a dozen members.
We’re not just offering an alternative party. We’re working for a better system. A system in which election rules are fair, primary voters aren’t locked into extremes, and public servants who work toward consensus problem-solving are rewarded. America deserves more choices, not more division.
[](https://home.forwardparty.com/donate?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_83a&n=8 "CHIP IN TO HELP ELECT MORE INDEPENDENTS") [CHIP IN TO HELP ELECT MORE INDEPENDENTS](https://home.forwardparty.com/donate?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_83a&n=8)
---
* * *
**[Utah Forward Party takes a novel approach to replace retiring Sen. Daniel Thatcher](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=KJIq8bn-hjzfGEfx24Ujf1cu9ghFUqJOGm4yb_0e-GouiGaTlK4VyePsLISUCT8JKB_e3-c_7027BmpgrZG45c-Rg704zLyY-B6lYSwpiUPh9K0Zp96DweROMtcNAdyhssU5BFb27Wc8-5gsaTOHP7t5xp3ZJHWJpSy3dWPSzKPEhP8Om7emPD_FxNWsRfpn&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_83a&n=9) | KUER** The usual procedure for a mid-term appointment is for party delegates in the district to choose a replacement. However, the Forward Party of Utah says it wants to do [ _something different_](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=EDpEEN4WZxgbOI9xtt0JkR7H6aRm-skMra84HXPU1VE&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_83a&n=10). “The unprecedented process we’re launching today gives the people of District 11, all of them, the power to decide who represents them,” Utah Forward Party Chair Michelle Quist said in a statement. “Parties don’t own these seats. People do.”

This virtual event will spotlight service, leadership, and reform, featuring Forward-endorsed veteran candidates and partners advancing democracy. For more information and to RSVP, click [here.](https://home.forwardparty.com/vmfc_october_general_meeting?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_83a&n=11) **October 29 | Black Voters Committee Candidate Forum** Join the Forward Party’s Black Voters Committee on October 29th at 8:30 PM ET | 5:30 PM PT for a virtual Candidate Forum featuring three inspiring leaders: Kenann McKenzie-Defranco (MA), candidate for Beverly City Council At-Large; Jazz Hampton (MN), candidate for Mayor of Minneapolis; and Jhamar Youngblood (NJ), candidate for Newark City Council Central Ward. For more information and to RSVP, click [here.](https://home.forwardparty.com/black_voters_committee_candidate_forum_oct_2025?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_83a&n=12)
[****](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=KsRbRlupkMENFsDlxp7flkcx8_xxQzkKAb7MgB1YMrByhnj4sje4BRVQM1-uGNHhgFi8N7bFbeE6G0P5bRxqrlqS-sG8Z0siEuI44bo4m-9-zr39gcVm7G_9hKi2QA_Yxu1cqhF01-zsM_s_xwFwMg&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_83a&n=13)[**Red States are preparing for an end to the Voting Rights Act**](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=wWw1LGKe09YoyrHaTkDQ4GG1qh98GYcXj0zaOWKzAETLXfPoBdHl0EIRr0kmG6Eqwj6DVvskezVPrhQY8thDVdHS3_sz7XBPFt_tIJ6uyfzVDfl8HLeLHbnnnfMYz0pD2WBmLwo1MRtkIYWpZWN8Mw&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_83a&n=14) | **Politico** Some Republicans across the south are preparing to redraw their congressional maps to boot Democrats out of office — if the Supreme Court issues a ruling on a case gutting the Voting Rights Act in time for the midterms.

| | Dorian Gray glanced at the picture, and suddenly an uncontrollable feeling of hatred for Basil Hallward came over him, as though it had been suggested to him by the image on the canvas, whispered into his ear by those grinning lips. The mad passions of a hunted animal stirred within him, and he loathed the man who was seated at the table, more than in his whole life he had ever loathed anything. He glanced wildly around. Something glimmered on the top of the painted chest that faced him. His eye fell on it. He knew what it was. It was a knife that he had brought up, some days before, to cut a piece of cord, and had forgotten to take away with him. He moved slowly towards it, passing Hallward as he did so. As soon as he got behind him, he seized it and turned round. Hallward stirred in his chair as if he was going to rise. He rushed at him and dug the knife into the great vein that is behind the ear, crushing the man’s head down on the table and stabbing again and again. There was a stifled groan and the horrible sound of some one choking with blood. Three times the outstretched arms shot up convulsively, waving grotesque, stiff-fingered hands in the air. He stabbed him twice more, but the man did not move. Something began to trickle on the floor. He waited for a moment, still pressing the head down. Then he threw the knife on the table, and listened. He could hear nothing, but the drip, drip on the threadbare carpet. He opened the door and went out on the landing. The house was absolutely quiet. No one was about. For a few seconds he stood bending over the balustrade and peering down into the black seething well of darkness. Then he took out the key and returned to the room, locking himself in as he did so. The thing was still seated in the chair, straining over the table with bowed head, and humped back, and long fantastic arms. Had it not been for the red jagged tear in the neck and the clotted black pool that was slowly widening on the table, one would have said that the man was simply asleep. How quickly it had all been done! He felt strangely calm, and walking over to the window, opened it and stepped out on the balcony. The wind had blown the fog away, and the sky was like a monstrous peacock’s tail, starred with myriads of golden eyes. He looked down and saw the policeman going his rounds and flashing the long beam of his lantern on the doors of the silent houses. The crimson spot of a prowling hansom gleamed at the corner and then vanished. A woman in a fluttering shawl was creeping slowly by the railings, staggering as she went. Now and then she stopped and peered back. Once, she began to sing in a hoarse voice. The policeman strolled over and said something to her. She stumbled away, laughing. A bitter blast swept across the square. The gas-lamps flickered and became blue, and the leafless trees shook their black iron branches to and fro. He shivered and went back, closing the window behind him.

Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. The Grand Hetman of the Crown, the future King of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Jan Sobieski, who knew Sirko well and met him in Bratslav in 1671.

The mad passions of a hunted animal stirred within him, and he loathed the man who was seated at the table, more than in his whole life he had ever loathed anything. He glanced wildly around. Something glimmered on the top of the painted chest that faced him. His eye fell on it. He knew what it was. It was a knife that he had brought up, some days before, to cut a piece of cord, and had forgotten to take away with him. He moved slowly towards it, passing Hallward as he did so. As soon as he got behind him, he seized it and turned round. Hallward stirred in his chair as if he was going to rise. He rushed at him and dug the knife into the great vein that is behind the ear, crushing the man’s head down on the table and stabbing again and again. There was a stifled groan and the horrible sound of some one choking with blood. Three times the outstretched arms shot up convulsively, waving grotesque, stiff-fingered hands in the air. He stabbed him twice more, but the man did not move. Something began to trickle on the floor. He waited for a moment, still pressing the head down. Then he threw the knife on the table, and listened. He could hear nothing, but the drip, drip on the threadbare carpet. He opened the door and went out on the landing. The house was absolutely quiet. No one was about. For a few seconds he stood bending over the balustrade and peering down into the black seething well of darkness. Then he took out the key and returned to the room, locking himself in as he did so. The thing was still seated in the chair, straining over the table with bowed head, and humped back, and long fantastic arms. Had it not been for the red jagged tear in the neck and the clotted black pool that was slowly widening on the table, one would have said that the man was simply asleep. How quickly it had all been done! He felt strangely calm, and walking over to the window, opened it and stepped out on the balcony. The wind had blown the fog away, and the sky was like a monstrous peacock’s tail, starred with myriads of golden eyes. He looked down and saw the policeman going his rounds and flashing the long beam of his lantern on the doors of the silent houses. The crimson spot of a prowling hansom gleamed at the corner and then vanished. A woman in a fluttering shawl was creeping slowly by the railings, staggering as she went. Now and then she stopped and peered back. Once, she began to sing in a hoarse voice. The policeman strolled over and said something to her. She stumbled away, laughing. A bitter blast swept across the square. The gas-lamps flickered and became blue, and the leafless trees shook their black iron branches to and fro. He shivered and went back, closing the window behind him. Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. “What can I do to help?” I’ve been asked this question at every meeting, every Town Hall, and even at the grocery store, since Day 1 of the Trump Administration and now throughout this government shutdown. I know this time is not easy for many of our neighbors and that the gridlock in Washington can feel hopeless. That is why, early this month and alongside the Maryland Democratic Party Chair Steuart Pittman, we hosted our first Organizing Town Hall to harness the power that our community has. We were joined by local democratic clubs, immigration experts, labor leaders, and over 100 Do-Something Democrats. I left feeling more inspired and ready to get to work.

## The key to keeping the House...
2026 is right around the corner, and one thing's for sure:
If we lose the House, we lose the agenda.
We lose the Republican advantage and a chance to get things done.
That's why the redistricting matters.
It's not just about a few votes here and there, righting mistakes from the past census.
This means the difference between a clear agenda, and weeks--months of subpoenas and impeachments.
Just look at the stakes.
This chart from Bruce Mehlman shows just how tight the margins are: the closest since 1931.

**This government shutdown was entirely avoidable but MAGA Republicans refuse to budge on their MAGA agenda, and now everyday Americans are paying the price.**

And now public broadcasting is in critical condition – staffers are being let go and local stations shutting down their programs.

If we don’t fix this ASAP, public broadcasting may shut down altogether.

## **EXCITING NEWS!**
---
| |

I'm thrilled to invite you to a special, intimate fundraising concert on **Saturday, November 1st** , with rising country music star **Trey Taylor!**
---
| |
**Trey Taylor's reached out to us - i** nspired by our fight to bring a new generation of leadership to Washington, Trey has generously offered to perform an intimate fundraising concert right here in Central Florida on **Saturday, November 1st**.

He has been an outspoken critic of the inhumane treatment of migrants and the way the billionaire class targets working-class communities, and he sees this race as a place where moral clarity can make a national impact.
---
| |

**For those who don't know him, Trey's story is incredible.** Discovered at 16 by Dolly Parton's longtime producer, he is the youngest African-American artist ever signed to a Nashville country music deal. Inspired by Dolly's own philanthropy, Trey has made it his mission to support leaders across the country who are fighting for justice and real results. He has been an outspoken critic of the way the billionaire class targets working-class communities, and he sees this race as a place where moral clarity can make a national impact.
---
| |

**This is a unique opportunity to hear his incredible music up close and support our people-powered movement. Every dollar raised goes directly to funding the outreach and field operations we need to take on one of the most corrupt incumbents in the country.**
---
|

| |

I did not run for Congress to become a creature of Wall Street.

**Then why are so many members of Congress getting rich off Wall Street?**

It's time this ended, Fellow American.

If you want to day-trade, leave Congress. _It's that simple_.

Congress shouldn't be able to profit from what it learns during closed-door meetings and committee hearings. The American people should have faith that Congress is working for the good of the country, not for its own bank accounts.

**[Fellow American, if you agree, I need you on my team.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=69998af4d67f4ee2a14be91e43f82765&_e=beCDMb-C46Jex5jn_fNgotTBcq7w7gp48z6PgYUdzVMbLR-RpjV9q_HMwcuAg49o5XEodidyPq7UkN9qTveRlSaPkn-S4h3lQpF_KESxhKjRTqT_8o_0YzFrD8Rhz9ppwrq5hXXN2B6oQ9aWsphLw9ba84n7HpQyPXxOfC4XEmXJAPrLjARnn5ntVP5shRqId6DFqdA1hEq9mhZYhSdHj2IU4MwfLn8DtaAwJb8BifiijXPpli1rVRfbceHzsrIocDfe5Xf4htC0DFUMIaEpw6lXQPp6U4k1jH-kXLFJTmLakSUbruU3e-kwv3JceRBfXqixu2hd_EOspqFCcP0lwY5gYnMY3xEVwsZdETYxiCRGQbgym2DLAWkEbDOs_ONVgDO-0U72Kwy-EjNrJ_WbLiJuLwraoWdTEiMcORlBsZpq766GTvFscxHeZ5KdThNqFtxSRtZ1cdSeJKf6sFpE_5XOfdkR7o2YqvCnlUWaX7OPU0IgCzS1ftxMVtwxbBGPAPRbS5-9sF0uxSmQAGQosumh3MjF37QLeYxX-rde3Z5U0RKZzHwrxVL8bhu6OLdsn9uyGydN35t6Drkag8IK_eou9XJQmuI9yn_EC3p0rMDjyOsrzROO2XB5CoRm8rIPdgQYzGSw6Eq92HhTsBxDMUbt2CrDnsec9NDQbx10VIrj0hTuOT7SdlL7nEOQQ9NkHKiQBQmmPq5vhmoK6YUbIA%3D%3D)**

Peter,

Picture 2002. You were renting movies at Blockbuster, maybe flipping open that new Motorola phone to call a buddy. CSI was must-watch TV, and the first iPods were hitting the shelves, promising a thousand songs in your pocket. That was the last time a Republican won a full Senate term in Minnesota. Twenty-three years. For over two decades, Democrats have treated this state like their personal fiefdom—silencing conservative voices, pushing radical policies, and turning our Minnesota values into a punching bag for their far-left agenda.

Enough is enough. It’s time to take our state - and our country – back.

I’m Adam Schwarze, born and raised in the Twin Cities—St. Paul kid, Bloomington hockey player, and a former Navy SEAL and Marine Corps veteran. **I enlisted on my 18th birthday, weeks after 9/11, because America called, and I answered. Nine deployments, 70 countries, leading SEAL teams through Iraq’s battlefields, commanding covert ops across the Pacific and Middle East, earning valor awards and early promotions—I’ve served with everything I’ve got. Now, I’m home, and what I see in Minnesota breaks my heart: skyrocketing prices crushing retirees, open borders flooding our communities with drugs and crime, and Tim Walz’s handpicked lieutenant governor, Peggy Flanagan, my opponent, ready to double down on the chaos.**

Peggy Flanagan? She’s Walz’s shadow: suing Minneapolis police while riots burned our cities in 2020, blaming law-and-order folks for her party’s failures, and now eyeing an open Minnesota Senate seat to push more tax hikes, fan the flame of culture wars not yet started, and spearhead policies that put illegals ahead of hardworking Minnesotans.

_**Under their watch, crime spiked. Walz talks “Minnesota nice,” but his budget cuts and fiscal flops have left our veterans ignored, our police underfunded, and our neighborhoods less safe.

We can flip this seat, secure the Republican Senate majority, and give President Trump the muscle to drain the swamp for good.

clean_body: Democrats have treated Minnesota like their personal fiefdom - but with your help, we can put those days behind us. | Peter, Picture 2002. You were renting movies at Blockbuster, maybe flipping open that new Motorola phone to call a buddy. CSI was must-watch TV, and the first iPods were hitting the shelves, promising a thousand songs in your pocket. That was the last time a Republican won a full Senate term in Minnesota. Twenty-three years. For over two decades, Democrats have treated this state like their personal fiefdom—silencing conservative voices, pushing radical policies, and turning our Minnesota values into a punching bag for their far-left agenda. Enough is enough. It’s time to take our state - and our country – back. I’m Adam Schwarze, born and raised in the Twin Cities—St. Paul kid, Bloomington hockey player, and a former Navy SEAL and Marine Corps veteran. I enlisted on my 18th birthday, weeks after 9/11, because America called, and I answered. Nine deployments, 70 countries, leading SEAL teams through Iraq’s battlefields, commanding covert ops across the Pacific and Middle East, earning valor awards and early promotions—I’ve served with everything I’ve got. Now, I’m home, and what I see in Minnesota breaks my heart: skyrocketing prices crushing retirees, open borders flooding our communities with drugs and crime, and Tim Walz’s handpicked lieutenant governor, Peggy Flanagan, my opponent, ready to double down on the chaos. Peggy Flanagan? She’s Walz’s shadow: suing Minneapolis police while riots burned our cities in 2020, blaming law-and-order folks for her party’s failures, and now eyeing an open Minnesota Senate seat to push more tax hikes, fan the flame of culture wars not yet started, and spearhead policies that put illegals ahead of hardworking Minnesotans. Under their watch, crime spiked. Walz talks “Minnesota nice,” but his budget cuts and fiscal flops have left our veterans ignored, our police underfunded, and our neighborhoods less safe. Here’s the spark: Recent polls from their own side show a generic Republican trailing by just two points. With United States Senator Tina Smith retiring, this seat is open for the first time in decades. Minnesota hasn’t gone red in a presidential race since Nixon in ’72, but the tide’s turning—Trump’s legacy is firing up folks like you, retired patriots who’ve built lives on hard work and faith. We can flip this seat, secure the Republican Senate majority, and give President Trump the muscle to drain the swamp for good. I’m running to cut taxes, back our police, secure the border, and defend the values you’ve spent your life upholding—family, faith, and freedom. We’re the underdogs, no question. Minnesota’s been blue since the days of dial-up internet. But I’ve led missions through worse odds—high-stakes ops where one mistake meant everything. Our last fundraising push got us halfway to our goal, but with Q4 filings looming and Flanagan raking in cash from coastal elites, You—retired vets, churchgoers, grandparents who’ve paid your dues—can fuel the ads, the door-knockers, the momentum to shock the system. You’ve got a choice. Delete this and let Democrats keep choking our future. Or stand with a battle-hardened SEAL ready to fight—not with noise, but with the quiet professionalism that wins wars. Help me make it real. Because we built this country on sacrifice and resolve, and we’re not done fighting. Fellow patriot —

# Trump presented with a touching gift that used to belong to his old friend
In Tokyo on Tuesday, Japan's new Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi invoked the late Shinzo Abe's golfing friendship with Donald Trump during their first summit,[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/bb24d45f-b789-4321-9920-1adb327fd035?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[gifting the U.S. president Abe's personal putter](https://substack.com/redirect/bb24d45f-b789-4321-9920-1adb327fd035?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to forge a personal bond and bolster bilateral security ties as she takes power.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bb24d45f-b789-4321-9920-1adb327fd035?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Symbolic Golf Legacy Revived** : Takaichi **[presented Trump with Abe's used putter,](https://substack.com/redirect/d12adfd1-6d98-4597-9e63-44cc6a1f6c06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** a gold-leaf ball, and a Hideki Matsuyama-signed bag, echoing the assassinated leader's rounds with Trump to build instant rapport.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/35aa592a-3513-4f05-9e2d-7dce99708bb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Trump 's Heart Wrenching Reaction**: Speaking through a translator upon being gifted it Trump asked: "Did he play with it?" Response, "Yes." Trump
"Such a wonderful man -- such a wonderful man."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0ea5624b-4071-4a7f-ad77-e0f24f04afd8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Strategic Alliance Building** : As assassinated Abe's protege, Takaichi leverages his "JAPAN IS BACK" catchphrase on signed caps, aiming to navigate trade frictions and boost defense spending through personal diplomacy.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/31335522-3d5e-4f6e-9aa2-c98dc9ea0cf0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Domestic Political Lifeline** : Facing a two-seat parliamentary shortfall, Takaichi's rising popularity from the meeting offers leverage for concessions, stabilizing her hardline conservative administration.
* **Eerie Assassination Echo** : Abe's killer's trial kicked off the same day in Takaichi's Nara hometown, underscoring emotional stakes as experts hail the Abe-tied approach for building alliance trust.

# US to build two AI supercomputers to revolutionize nuclear and cancer research
In a groundbreaking push for scientific dominance, the U.S. Department of Energy unveiled a $1 billion partnership with AMD to construct two supercomputers, harnessing AI **[to revolutionize fusion energy, cancer treatments,](https://substack.com/redirect/72a08079-b325-4cf0-ac2c-408f64c9dc0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and national security.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/72a08079-b325-4cf0-ac2c-408f64c9dc0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Lux Deployment Accelerates AI:** The first supercomputer, Lux, leverages AMD's MI355X chips and is set to launch within six months, offering triple the AI capacity of existing systems through collaboration with HPE, Oracle, and Oak Ridge National Lab.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5e99a7d1-3338-4c6f-a15d-2808f706347b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* **Hivemind Autonomy Defies Jamming** : Onboard AI system interprets threats in real-time, rerouting missions and identifying targets without GPS or constant human input, ensuring operations in denied environments.
