_**By David Shuster**_
Once upon a term infernal, through a midnight dark, nocturnal,
While I watched the news external, trembling at Trump's fresh uproar--
While I pondered, weak and[ weary, over the state of freedom's theory](https://substack.com/redirect/13ca0cc5-3221-4b25-ab2a-044e540c027e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),
Suddenly there came a query, echoing through the chamber door--
"Is this justice still?" I whispered, staring through that oaken door--
Answer came: "Not anymore."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fffece70-b3af-46d3-b4df-69b0e10529f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Ah, distinctly I remember, through that bleak and cursed November,
When the votes, as dying embers, flickered faintly--counted sore.
Each decree grew more despotic, every dawn more chaotic,
And the courts, once proud and stoic, bowed before Trump's gilded floor--
[Bowed before his wrath and bluster, where he trampled oath and lore](https://substack.com/redirect/716e081e-4e89-4563-88b2-34bae53b5d58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--
Law lay bleeding--evermore.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/13ca0cc5-3221-4b25-ab2a-044e540c027e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b8e2b846-a5a9-4592-aef0-242869d5f285?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Then from every screen and station came a torrent of dictation,
"Fake!" he cried at truth's foundation, "Only I define what's sure!"
And his flock, in blind elation, hailed his lies as revelation,
While the facts of every nation sank beneath his dark rapport--
Reason drowned in endless echo, lost beneath his fevered roar--
Sanity--forevermore.
And the traitors once convicted, those whose hands the law restricted,
Found their pardon unrestricted--["Patriots!" he called their score](https://substack.com/redirect/1c339581-9435-479e-8d11-e84f6e45b680?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
From their crimes he made confession into twisted proud procession,
[Blessed rebellion's old transgression, swore their sins would count no more](https://substack.com/redirect/fffece70-b3af-46d3-b4df-69b0e10529f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--
Thus the oath of justice shattered on the Capitol's old floor--
Freedom dying--evermore.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0dd471a3-bd7a-47a3-bc53-b1fca5948833?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Tariffs raged like storms unending, markets broke with no amending,
Farmers wept, their prayers ascending](https://substack.com/redirect/c36b48bc-1aa0-4c8e-9cc5-ea85ef887173?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to an empty marble floor.
"Great again!" Trump thundered, lying, as the factories fell, dying,
While economists were sighing, "This makes no one rich but war."
But the echo of his madness filled the sky forevermore--
Truth degraded--evermore.
Then the borders groaned in sorrow--families torn, no bright tomorrow,
[Children vanished, hearts grown hollow, ](https://substack.com/redirect/b0b38db6-7309-4311-ba2d-0786c8195da7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)cast beyond the nation's shore.
"Law is mine!" he cried, deriding, all due process now subsiding,
And the guards, ashamed, abiding, turned away from what they saw--
As the weeping met the silence of a Constitution's flaw--
Mercy broken--evermore.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b8e2b846-a5a9-4592-aef0-242869d5f285?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5d93c2d2-3897-44a0-bbc4-1a0693efed49?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[To the East Wing came his hammer--tearing marble, hurling clamor](https://substack.com/redirect/03553d93-0cd7-4b92-a0d0-d5cd4c777ff0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),
Saying, "History's dead glamour--tear it down, it's mine once more!"
So the halls of truth and reason fell to vanity's imprecision
While the portraits, each derision, burned beside his golden door.
[Lincoln's shade stood silent weeping](https://substack.com/redirect/2fd45526-984a-4ca5-8f8d-c9086e6fb3c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on that desecrated floor--
Union trembling--evermore.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4227135f-b0d3-4ef8-994f-768c93509a33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b8e2b846-a5a9-4592-aef0-242869d5f285?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Then without consent or warning, in a blood red tropic morning,
[Bombs fell down, the ships adorning seas where peace had been before](https://substack.com/redirect/757d4119-1533-4091-ad2b-c0d4e3197f98?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
"Cartel boats!" he cried, elated, "I alone have terminated!"
Congress left un-consultated--law defied, as oft before.
And the world looked on in horror at this tyrant's private war--
Honor buried--evermore.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d8baf196-498b-4ce1-b561-ffc9d55fd812?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And the Raven, black and knowing, perched upon the flag now showing,
Watched the republic's embers glowing faintly through corruption's door.
From his eyes fell sparks of warning, lighting graves where truth lay mourning,
While the tyrant, ever scorning, smirked and bragged his false encore:
"Are we lost?" I cried, imploring, "Can this land be what it swore?"
Quote the Raven: **" Nevermore."**
_Yet beneath that word of sorrow, whispered hope for some tomorrow,_
[Rose from hearts too brave to borrow silence ](https://substack.com/redirect/e6f7c7c4-35b6-48ce-8315-3f492a779a42?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)from the tyrant's lore.
In the streets they gathered, pleading, for the truth the nation's needing--
[Swore their love of justice, bleeding, would outlast the despot's war](https://substack.com/redirect/536f1b0c-239c-4cc3-9e8f-ea5a1d63bed2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
And the Raven took his shadow, soaring toward the sun once more--
Freedom rising--**Evermore.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6efb0637-6e06-4cb8-a09b-2345a6926b6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b8e2b846-a5a9-4592-aef0-242869d5f285?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

While Donald Trump plans a lavish Thanksgiving in his gold-plated White House, 41 million Americans won’t be able to afford groceries because the administration is illegally suspending SNAP benefits.
I filed a lawsuit today against Trump’s USDA and Secretary Brooke Rollins for unlawfully suspending SNAP benefits during the federal government shutdown.
If you’re with me, add your name to demand that the Trump administration fully fund SNAP benefits — now. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/774XILbTuEu4V-S-GzVTNA2]
Let’s be clear: USDA is sitting on billions of dollars in contingency funds for situations like this. Not only do they have the authority to use that money to fund SNAP benefits — they have a legal duty to do it.
SNAP benefits can and must be provided, shutdown or not. In fact, SNAP has always been funded during past shutdowns.
Instead, Trump and his administration are playing politics with an essential safety net that tens of millions of lower-income families, seniors, and individuals with disabilities rely on to put food on the table. That includes 5.5 million Californians alone — 63% of whom are children or elderly.
The holidays are around the corner. Grocery prices are soaring. And food banks are facing unprecedented demand. If the Trump administration gets its way, families will go hungry just so it can make a political point.
This isn’t just illegal. It’s cruel.

Friend,
I have some absolutely incredible news: [**For the second consecutive filing period, we have outraised our opponent!**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=55f1a0d930&e=606d7e9aa2)**** We raised **$12,795** from **82 contributors** , while our opponent raised **$8,198** from only **12 contributors.**
When we launched this campaign, **the political establishment wrote us off**. They looked at the incumbent's war chest and the endless special interest money flowing their way and **declared this race over before it even began**. They said we couldn’t compete. They said we couldn’t build a grassroots movement strong enough to challenge that kind of power.
Thanks to dedicated supporters like you making small-dollar donations, we didn't just keep pace, we surged past them again. Honestly, **we should not be in this good of a position** right now. This is a testament to the fact that people power still matters.

### Now for the Final Push: GOTV
###
This financial victory is thrilling, but it's only a momentum builder. We can’t allow this hard work and these historic wins to stop short of the finish line.

Today is National Immigrants Day. This day is supposed to honor the millions of immigrants who’ve built this country with their hands, hearts, and hope.
But here’s the irony: while America may celebrate immigrants on paper, Trump and his ICE regime are still hunting them down in practice.
They call it “law and order.” We call it cruelty with a badge.
Families are being torn apart, children locked in cages, and asylum seekers treated like criminals... ICE raids are ramping up, detention centers are expanding, and Trump’s deploying federal agents across major cities.
So this Halloween, we’re saying it plainly: It’s time for Trump and his ICE brigade to take their masks off.
Behind their “border security” costume is the same hateful, profit-driven system that dehumanizes Black and brown immigrants every single day.
Cori is running for Congress again because she believes our communities deserve real safety, not fear. We deserve leaders who will fight to end ICE’s reign of terror and build an immigration system rooted in justice and humanity—not work to preserve it.

name: Sara Fontes, LCV
subject: DEADLINE SOON: Make NAFTA 2.0 a Deal That Delivers for People and Planet
body:
We need to hear from you ASAP.

If you are unable to see the message below, [click here to view](https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTMxMTU4NzIS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjMyMDk3NjI5MQS2&mt=1&rt=0).
| | | |
---
| | | | Peter,
---
| | Instead of helping working people, President Trump’s trade deals have prioritized the interests of greedy corporations.
---
| | Now, Trump’s signature trade deal with Canada and Mexico — which helps corporations destroy jobs and increases labor and environmental exploitation both at home and abroad — is up for review.
---
| | The Trump administration must hear from all of us on how it should approach the required review of the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement, also known as NAFTA 2.0.
---
| | [**_Tell Trump’s U.S. Trade Representative, our country’s lead trade negotiator, that trade with Canada and Mexico must include strong environmental protections, support for good green jobs, and regional cooperation to create more sustainable and resilient manufacturing sectors and supply chains._**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/-)
---
| | Decades of bad trade policy, starting in the 1990s, led to a decline in American manufacturing since then, the outsourcing of hundreds of thousands of good-paying American jobs, and a huge increase in global climate pollution. The North American Free Trade Agreement **(NAFTA)** that took effect in 1994 was perhaps the most notorious U.S. trade deal, **where working people and the environment were sold out to benefit multinational corporations.**
---
| | Right now, we have a rapidly disappearing opportunity to push for changes to the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement **(USMCA)** that prioritize environmental and labor protections and clean manufacturing. A revised USMCA must include stronger and binding labor and environmental provisions and establish new enforcement to ensure that manufacturers and polluters in all three countries are playing by the same rules. Not only will this help ensure we have cleaner air and water but also a thriving economy for all.
---
| | **We need to hear from you ASAP.** [**Sign today and urge the U.S. Trade Representative to prioritize environmental protection, transparency on remaining pollution levels, and clean manufacturing in USMCA talks, so we do not repeat the mistakes of past trade deals.**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/bxyvTVGe_aJ7/dmZCVWNFNURuMXF4UnlTV0FCM1Z3NFE4SThKcUhLRmgwSVhHdEVORlRQNEhpVk9BaTRjcis4K3Vmb2taZC9NS0dXczdvR0gyY0RrN1VGVGN5WVVQR3lJcGdnbVRpVmJYY2FZTnpzZmsveG89S0/TEtrNDF3OGxRTWRCa0FIYW4xSjNKc1FzSElYRy9ZWHB4TVlrZHJ5NFBrdjR0VTg2S0t4WFU2UXRjZFpVYnFjbHVacWs1LzNvdFZhbXFLZU9nZVlsaFh1dnYvcW92NHdjRXhveDhCWHIvWkk9S0)
---
| | Thank you for helping to protect people and the planet, Peter.
---
| | Sara Fontes, LCV Senior Advocate on Clean Energy and Climate Change
---
| | |
* * *
---

If this isn't the best email address at which to reach you,[ _update your contact information_](https://www.pages08.net/leagueofconservationvoters/forms/ContactInformation?spMailingID=13115872&spUserID=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&spJobID=MjMyMDk3NjI5MQS2&spReportId=MjMyMDk3NjI5MQS2) _._ [_Click here to unsubscribe_](https://www.pages08.net/leagueofconservationvoters/forms/Unsubscribe?spMailingID=13115872&spUserID=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&spJobID=MjMyMDk3NjI5MQS2&spReportId=MjMyMDk3NjI5MQS2) from our supporter list. # **Bill Gates reverses climate doomsday warnings after decades of alarmism**
Bill Gates, who spent over a decade warning that climate change posed unimaginable peril, now states **[in a blog post](https://substack.com/redirect/b03e94a1-cf48-44d0-8275-4c8a0a003d2f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that "climate change will not lead to humanity's demise" and urges a shift away from the "doomsday outlook" adopted by many climate activists.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b03e94a1-cf48-44d0-8275-4c8a0a003d2f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Acknowledges unintended harm to developing nations:** The Microsoft co-founder, whose foundation has funded greenhouse gas reduction projects including technology to dim the sun, noted that obsessive focus on emissions cuts has negatively impacted poor countries, citing examples like a low-income nation whose synthetic fertilizer ban caused plummeting crop yields and a food crisis, and how wealthy shareholders pressuring fossil fuel divestment made it harder for poor nations to get loans for reliable electricity.
* **Cold deadlier than heat, success should prioritize welfare:** Gates points out that "excessive cold is far deadlier, killing nearly ten times more people every year than heat does," and argues "we should measure success by our impact on human welfare more than our impact on the global temperature," concluding that "climate change is not the biggest threat to the lives and livelihoods of people in poor countries."

# Charlie Kirk suspected assassin's transgender lover has disappeared
Lance Twiggs, 22, the transgender boyfriend of Tyler Robinson--who allegedly shot Turning Point USA co-founder Charlie Kirk dead at Utah Valley University on September 10--**[has seemingly vanished](https://substack.com/redirect/8c26333b-5c8e-4ffa-8621-11363798f7c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from his St. George, Utah apartment and hasn't been seen in six weeks, though authorities say he is cooperating with the investigation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8c26333b-5c8e-4ffa-8621-11363798f7c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Lance Twiggs via Lance Twiggs' TikTok
* **Connection to the killer:** Federal authorities say Robinson sent Twiggs a string of text messages confessing to the slaying during a 33-hour manhunt before surrendering to police. Twiggs later shared the messages with law enforcement and is cooperating with the investigation, but not the media.
* **Alleged assassin heads to court:** Meanwhile, Robinson made a brief court appearance Monday where he successfully argued to wear civilian clothes at future hearings, with his arraignment scheduled for Jan. 30 on charges including aggravated murder.
* **Troubled backstory:** Twiggs and Robinson moved in together after Twiggs' devout Mormon parents allegedly kicked him out in 2018. Venmo records show Twiggs' parents sending him money for prescriptions and gas in recent years, suggesting some reconciliation.
* **Criminal charges** : Twiggs has not been charged with any crime. His car is now parked at his parents' home, though it's unclear where he is currently living.

name: Rear Admiral Michael Baker, U.S. Navy, Retired
subject: RE: Donald Trump wants a war
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
I wanted to make sure you took note of the email Dr. Michael Baker sent to you yesterday. He spent more than three decades in uniform and retired with the rank of Rear Admiral. A distinguished and decorated leader who deserves your attention.
#
Peter, Paul Eaton here.
I wanted to make sure you took note of the email Dr. Michael Baker sent to you yesterday. He spent more than three decades in uniform and retired with the rank of Rear Admiral. A distinguished and decorated leader who deserves your attention.
You can find that email below, but to sum it up quickly: Donald Trump is attempting to rush our country into a needless war of choice with Venezuela. It’s critical that all VoteVets supporters are aware of that, and are ready to mobilize to stop it while we still can.
I’ll add that our senior commanders are being put in the position of executing orders for criminal strikes, for which they may one day be held to account. We have just had a SOUTHCOM commander retire early in the face of lethal strikes against boats from Venezuela and Colombia.
None of this serves America, or our military. In fact, the Trump administration is putting our troops at risk.
[**If you’re with us in opposition to another Forever War, I’m asking you to read Adm. Baker’s email below and add your name to the thousands of others who have already signed our petition.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/251027_vv_forever_war/?source=em251028-1-120&akid=34733%2E3013755%2EuA4h_A)
| [NO MORE FOREVER WAR](https://act.votevets.org/signup/251027_vv_forever_war/?source=em251028-1-120&akid=34733%2E3013755%2EuA4h_A)
---
Gratefully,
Paul Eaton
Major General, U.S. Army, Retired
Senior Advisor, VoteVets

* * *

Peter, this is Dr. Michael Baker. Rear Admiral, U.S. Navy, retired. I’m writing to you on behalf of VoteVets today.
In my time, I had numerous deployments and assignments doing policy and strategic planning across three decades in uniform.
Two days ago, Donald Trump ordered the USS Gerald R. Ford into the Caribbean, alongside eight other warships and a nuclear submarine. Around the same time, Stephen Miller dodged a question about sending American troops to Venezuela. And yesterday, on CBS News, Senator Lindsey Graham spoke of Trump’s plan to brief members of Congress on an expansion of operations, “from the sea to the land.”
It’s clear that Donald Trump wants a war. Colin Powell had something to say about the use of force and bars that must be met. Let’s consider just 4 of his 8 points here:
**First, is a vital national security interest threatened?** The nation of Venezuela poses no threat to the USA. We use the Coast Guard and law enforcement to stop drug boats rather than million-dollar munitions to perform extrajudicial killings of unknown people. I participated in River and Coastal Patrol, and a board and search is the way to determine who is on the boat and what is on it.
**Second, do we have a clear, attainable objective?** The administration’s goal is to show the world how tough Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth are. The truth, of course, is that both are insecure and out of their depth. Both are trying to consolidate power further. And, perhaps, they hope to distract from the “Epstein Files” and Trump’s destruction of the White House. Like a crime family boss.
**Third, have the risks and costs been fully and frankly analyzed?** We risk exacerbating an 80-year tradition of making more enemies and further isolating our country. We will spend millions per day to deploy the Ford carrier battle group – while federal employees line up at food banks, kids lose school lunches, and poor families lose basic health care.
**And finally, have all other non-violent policy means been fully exhausted?** What about diplomacy? Foreign Aid? Voice of America? And how about USAID designed to help less fortunate people, rather than bombing them? We know those haven’t been exhausted because DOGE cut them all. Still, history shows that generosity and compassion, as we saw with the Marshall Plan's rebuilding of Europe – including assistance to former enemy combatants – turned those nations into staunch allies.
Powell emphasized the importance of a nation exhausting all "political, economic, and diplomatic means", which, only if all were futile, would result in the condition that the nation should resort to military force. We have exhausted none of those means.
"Those who cannot remember the past are condemned to repeat it." Trump and Hegseth didn’t learn a thing after two decades of needless war tore our country apart. Their childlike vindictiveness will ruin our country further, if we let it.
But that story is not written. Not yet. The American people don’t want another war — least of all the veterans who fought the last ones. We have time, still, to join our voices in opposition before it’s too late.
So, I am writing to you with a simple request. [**Add your voice to thousands of others who have signed on with VoteVets, and tell Donald Trump to stop this war before it starts. No more Forever Wars. No more Gold Star Families.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/251027_vv_forever_war/?source=em251028-1-120&akid=34733%2E3013755%2EuA4h_A)
| [NO MORE FOREVER WAR](https://act.votevets.org/signup/251027_vv_forever_war/?source=em251028-1-120&akid=34733%2E3013755%2EuA4h_A)
---
That signature may seem like a small action compared to the power Trump holds. But the only thing that has ever changed our country for the better is millions of people joining together with a common goal.
That’s how this fight begins, but it doesn’t end here.
Please, add your name.
S/F
MB
Michael Baker, MD
Rear Admiral, USN (ret)

For God, Family, and Country, Mark Lamb Republican for Congress, AZ-5 P.S. While on his set, I couldn’t help but relive the tragic day we lost Charlie Kirk and the loss that I, and all of us, felt. body:
| **It’s pretty clear that Donald Trump is afraid of me.**

Trump has publicly endorsed my opponent (after Jack shamelessly begged for his support). He’s attacked me by name in multiple, unhinged rants on social media. His administration _illegally leaked my private records to Jack’s campaign ally._

**But friend, Trump is even more afraid of the movement we’ve built together here in New Jersey — because if we win, we will send a powerful message to the nation that the people do not support his destructive and incompetent presidency.**

That’s why he’s doing _everything he can_ to stop us from winning this upcoming election, and is rallying the support of his deep-pocketed allies to flood this race with spending against us.

[Donald Trump knows that as governor, I’m going to do everything in my power to fight back against his disastrous agenda. But polling shows a neck-and-neck race, which means we absolutely can’t let Trump’s attacks go unanswered. Can you split a donation between NJ Victory 25 and the Voter Protection Project today to help me finish this race with the strength we need to win it?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/95526?t=6&akid=21631%2E878179%2Eo8hkLq) | [DONATE »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/95542?t=7&akid=21631%2E878179%2Eo8hkLq)

[The fact is, we are far from guaranteed a victory here. The race is a toss-up, and if we’re going to win, we’ll have to earn it. So I’m calling on the support of my grassroots team for help in this final stretch. Will you split a donation between NJ Victory 25 and the Voter Protection Project to help me pull ahead of Jack?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/95526?t=8&akid=21631%2E878179%2Eo8hkLq)

Peter, We recently got word that Legacy Health Systems is closing every one of their urgent care centers in our area on November 15.
---
| [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqv6r8GR7zKbLdKY8JcRsBH8aQhQzL-6XFLiJ1IzrYZqHcVu3_2xEWSSvdjjDmkiSUA1pmS2XBGNhoqS9jIzxz9Leh2DEpm3oAjEnuDfjXCz9SsqhTvaqJIyFBiy5Ec13_TxWUADAsKbdLZbZDFjbRndJAaFfqNA3fESNyGmb3LK57kRo8fgPAsIgvy6v4CeyeV_F1w642p22bObYGA4YhgBgYzP5tXBuLmlR9F9Cn2B-OIXdMD8zMf12P21p4pDg4jMvQfnCWCZVWPfTU5StJSt3DzEyZ_2fLjbSJXZLfTtGgy8sxBvmES7-AiEJBpwsN7Y0HSxnZK_dGfiU6NPZFFNauBRn5ZoXqln1ZJR3Oratg/4l4/Y1DJ1CJeSO-GCzGzXtuFvg/h1/h001.P9QUemKp0O-fkiRUkaC1kda2XfI7wpN--GHfjHv6zcs)
---
That's four urgent care centers that provide routine, preventative, and urgent medical care to our community. All about to shut their doors because of economic uncertainty around the government shutdown, planned cuts to Medicaid, and the uncertain future of the Affordable Care Act that millions of Americans rely on for health insurance.
Working families in Washington and all across America are about to be hammered with yet another devastating economic blow if Republicans allow the ACA tax credits to expire. It's hard enough for most folks to put food on the table and keep a roof over their heads. When your health insurance bill goes from $500 a month to $2000 (according to new data from the Kaiser Family Foundation), that is going to CRUSH people who might otherwise be getting by. body:
I do: My old Cutlass Supreme

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. [To unsubscribe from this email list, please click here.](https://act.haleyformi.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?&t=1&akid=1213%2E49239%2EN5bbCp)

[](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/7709?t=3&akid=1213%2E49239%2EN5bbCp)
**I bet you still remember getting handed the keys to your first car, null.** I sure do.
That old, used Cutlass Supreme? It meant more to me than just freedom.
I always knew I wanted to spend my life fighting for the people and communities I love. When the Great Recession hit and the American car industry faced extinction, I wanted to step up and do something for my state. So I answered the call to serve as chief of staff to President Obama’s Auto Rescue initiative, and we helped save over 200,000 Michigan jobs and stabilize our economy.
Fast forward to today, and Michigan jobs are once again at risk, this time from Donald Trump and his reckless tariffs – which are threatening the jobs of tens of thousands of hardworking Michiganders.
**Trump said he “couldn’t care less” if auto prices rise.**
Well, as someone who has spent my time in Congress fighting for Michigan jobs, Michigan families, and Michigan workers, _I couldn’t care more_.
That’s why I’m in this race, null – because just like that day I got the keys to my old Cutlass, we have the power to chart a new path. I’m determined to become Michigan’s next senator, stop Trump’s chaos, and keep fighting for working families here in Michigan and across the country. But I need your help.
Our race in Michigan will decide Senate control, and _The Cook Political Report_ rated it a “Toss Up.” The GOP is going to come after me with everything they’ve got, and I can’t fight back without your grassroots support. That’s why it’s so important to reach our $350,000 end-of-month goal – and why I’m personally asking:
**[Will you chip in $5 – or whatever you can give today – to help me win in Michigan, take back the Senate for Democrats, and keep up my fight for working families?](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/7709?t=4&akid=1213%2E49239%2EN5bbCp)**

Haley Stevens
|

**A note from Haley Stevens:** Null, I’m proud to be a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. That’s why I’ve fought so hard for working families my entire life. Now, I’m running for Michigan’s open Senate seat to continue fighting for the people and communities I love. The path to the Senate majority runs right through Michigan, which means this race is shaping up to be the most competitive and expensive in the entire country. The GOP is already coming after me as a top target for defeat, so I’m counting on your grassroots support to fight back and win. | | Dorian Gray glanced at the picture, and suddenly an uncontrollable feeling of hatred for Basil Hallward came over him, as though it had been suggested to him by the image on the canvas, whispered into his ear by those grinning lips. The mad passions of a hunted animal stirred within him, and he loathed the man who was seated at the table, more than in his whole life he had ever loathed anything. He glanced wildly around. Something glimmered on the top of the painted chest that faced him. His eye fell on it. He knew what it was. It was a knife that he had brought up, some days before, to cut a piece of cord, and had forgotten to take away with him. He moved slowly towards it, passing Hallward as he did so. As soon as he got behind him, he seized it and turned round. Hallward stirred in his chair as if he was going to rise. He rushed at him and dug the knife into the great vein that is behind the ear, crushing the man’s head down on the table and stabbing again and again. There was a stifled groan and the horrible sound of some one choking with blood. Three times the outstretched arms shot up convulsively, waving grotesque, stiff-fingered hands in the air. Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. The Grand Hetman of the Crown, the future King of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Jan Sobieski, who knew Sirko well and met him in Bratslav in 1671.

# EXCITING DC TRIP -- AND MY VIRAL VIDEO ON ZOHRAN MAMDANI

EXCITING DC TRIP I had a most exciting DC trip last week! I visited staff at the White House Executive Office Building, followed by a very special visit with US Secretary of Health and Human Services Robert F. Kennedy. You may recall that Secretary Kennedy endorsed me in my New Hampshire 2nd District Congressional campaign last year, just two days before the election. Last week I finally got a chance to thank him in person. He is very genuine. From an impoverished little girl who survived Mao’s brutal regime to a Congressional candidate visiting the White House, I am humbled. I am truly blessed to be an American living in the Granite State!

After my White House visit, I headed to the US Capitol, where I made this video to call out Democrats who shut down our government and have refused to pay essential Federal employees: _[https://youtube.com/shorts/n4OofACDuwc?si=-ZHi1jNEM9ydmdkO](https://lilytangwilliams.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8317033781a524f5f640e7e3e&id=e430569777&e=c338950e03)_

Please view and share the video: [https://x.com/i/status/1982134272925241357](https://lilytangwilliams.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8317033781a524f5f640e7e3e&id=f4ed3ccb36&e=c338950e03)
All my supporters know me as a passionate defender of American values and the US Constitution. Could you please join us in contributing to my Congressional campaign in New Hampshire? Thank you to those who have already contributed \-- I am asking for your continued support, please! We ended the last quarter with $420,000 in donations-- most of those from my home state of New Hampshire. I am truly a grassroots candidate supported by the people. Contrast that against my opponent, Rep. Maggie Goodlander, who has $1.2 million cash on hand - mostly from large and powerful donors _outside_ of New Hampshire. They want to reach in from the outside to continue Democrat control of this seat in Congress and advance their national agenda. Thank you so much for your support at this important time!

Peter,

The Squad has faced relentless attacks from far-right forces who’ve tried
to roll back our fundamental rights, push forward their self-serving
agenda, and do everything they can to cling onto power.

Their goal is clear: drown out the voices demanding real, transformative
change and slow the momentum of our people-powered movement. But we have
something they don’t — you.

People like you,
Peter, have always been the
driving force behind this movement. The Squad doesn’t answer to
billionaires or corporate PACs — we’re powered by grassroots supporters
and working people who believe in justice, equity, and a democracy that
works for all of us, not just the wealthy few.

We’ll be real with you: we’re not where we need to be with our
end-of-month fundraising deadline this Friday. We’re tracking behind, and
we need to close this gap fast to keep building the movement we’ve started
together.

This isn’t just about hitting a number, it’s about building collective
power to challenge the status quo — Medicare for All, a Green New Deal,
affordable housing, student debt relief, and more. That’s how we win — by
standing together and fueling a movement that can’t be bought.

The Squad is uplifting the voices of the working-class everyday, leading
the fight for our democracy boldly and unapologetically. But this work
doesn’t happen alone — we depend on grassroots momentum behind us to keep
this movement strong.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Yes on Prop 50 in California
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2690%2E4032634%2ELYGK7_)
---
Republicans secretly know that the American people hate their policies. They know their politicians are deeply unpopular. They know voters are sick and tired of watching Donald Trump spend money on his White House ballroom and private jet upgrades while cutting Medicaid and SNAP benefits. Put simply, Republicans are worried that Americans will vote them out in the 2026 midterms. But instead of offering up better, more popular ideas, they’ve decided to redraw Congressional maps in their favor. Donald Trump has been calling up Republican-controlled states, demanding they find ways to give the party more seats and total control. This kind of blatant power grab can’t go unanswered. That’s why I’m behind California all the way on Governor Newsom’s responsible solution to Republican gerrymandering. His Prop 50 proposes new lines to California’s congressional districts that level the playing field — adding five seats that lean Democratic to balance out Texas’s gerrymander that added five Republican-leaning seats. But unlike Texas Republicans’ power grab, California’s Prop 50 is being determined by voters on a ballot — not by politicians in a shady backroom deal. **As Republican politicians work to silence voters through unprecedented mid-year redistricting, California voters have the opportunity to fight back.** [**With one week until Election Day, we need to ensure that we are connecting with every voter possible on this ballot initiative. Will you split a donation between Yes on 50 — Governor Newsom’s Ballot Measure Committee — and our campaign to fight back against Trump’s power grab?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3194?t=8&akid=2690%2E4032634%2ELYGK7_)

I want to be clear: Redistricting should be independent, and I’ve long supported redistricting committees that take the politics out of redistricting. That’s the standard for making sure voters pick their politicians, rather than the politicians picking their voters. That’s the long-term goal. But Democrats can't live in a world anymore where we pretend that everybody is playing by the same set of rules. Right now, Republicans are determined to rig every rule they can, to break laws, and to ignore laws in order to be able to seize power and to hang on to it. We have a responsibility to find creative, forceful ways to do something about these attempts to push us closer and closer to an oligarchy where voters are silenced and billionaires call the shots. We’re in uncharted territory here, and we have to fight like it. [**California has the chance to fight back against this attempt to silence the will of the people. With early voting underway, will you split a donation between Yes on 50 and our campaign so that we can defend our democracy?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3194?t=14&akid=2690%2E4032634%2ELYGK7_) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

Team, The past few weeks have been jam-packed with events, trainings, and rallies. I even joined Jen Psaki on MSNBC. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118187674/578941056/-1313101069?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_FLHP_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20251028_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzhjNDViMGYtNTliNC1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Of4A2wNuqNF56VwbXTrPZ0s0OVPMa0sHUDNvWERf4eE=) On her show, I shared a story about our recent Fight Like Hell PAC training in Wisconsin. I was meeting with voters at a local bar, and a man named Bill working in the kitchen came around from behind the counter and told us, _“No one’s talking to the middle class anymore. My health care costs keep going up.**We need help.** ”_ That conversation stuck with me — because he’s right. Too many people feel like no one is showing up for them. That’s exactly why I started Fight Like Hell PAC, and it’s guiding our strategy as we prepare for upcoming elections. **I’m working hard to recruit and train candidates and staff who listen, meet people where they are, and focus on what really matters** — lowering costs, putting money back in people’s pockets, and making sure everyone has what they need to get ahead. **[I’m asking you to help us show up. We can only do this with grassroots support. Pitch in right now, and let’s get to work:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118187675/578941057/-1313101069?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_FLHP_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20251028_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzhjNDViMGYtNTliNC1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Of4A2wNuqNF56VwbXTrPZ0s0OVPMa0sHUDNvWERf4eE=)** | | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/118187676/578941058/-1313101069?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_FLHP_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20251028_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzhjNDViMGYtNTliNC1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Of4A2wNuqNF56VwbXTrPZ0s0OVPMa0sHUDNvWERf4eE=)

We’ve seen this strategy work in Michigan. When we show up in every community, we can feed more kids at school, cut retirement taxes, and make sure folks who work overtime actually see that pay reflected in their paycheck. That’s what we just did with our bipartisan budget package.
And this is the vision I’m working to scale across the country, **but National Republicans are already flooding the airwaves and organizing in places they think we won’t go.** If we want to keep winning, we have to meet people on their turf — and that takes resources, people, and grit.

clean_body: Let’s prove that we’re going to show up everywhere | Team, The past few weeks have been jam-packed with events, trainings, and rallies. I even joined Jen Psaki on MSNBC. = On her show, I shared a story about our recent Fight Like Hell PAC training in Wisconsin. I was meeting with voters at a local bar, and a man named Bill working in the kitchen came around from behind the counter and told us, “No one’s talking to the middle class anymore. My health care costs keep going up.We need help. ” That conversation stuck with me — because he’s right. Too many people feel like no one is showing up for them. That’s exactly why I started Fight Like Hell PAC, and it’s guiding our strategy as we prepare for upcoming elections. I’m working hard to recruit and train candidates and staff who listen, meet people where they are, and focus on what really matters — lowering costs, putting money back in people’s pockets, and making sure everyone has what they need to get ahead. = | | = We’ve seen this strategy work in Michigan. When we show up in every community, we can feed more kids at school, cut retirement taxes, and make sure folks who work overtime actually see that pay reflected in their paycheck. That’s what we just did with our bipartisan budget package. And this is the vision I’m working to scale across the country, but National Republicans are already flooding the airwaves and organizing in places they think we won’t go. If we want to keep winning, we have to meet people on their turf — and that takes resources, people, and grit. So here’s my question: How are people going to know what we're fighting for if we don’t show up?= If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = = | = = | = = Thanks for being part of this fight. subject: No, it’s not too late
body:
---
Derek, In just a moment, we’re going to ask you to make a contribution to help Democrats win BIG on Election Day in just one week. But before we do, we want to answer a question that might be on your mind: _Is it too late to contribute and make a difference in this year’s elections?_ The answer is no! In fact, that’s exactly what Trump and his allies want you to think. They want all of us to decide it’s too late to make a difference and take our foot off the gas in these final days. We can’t do that. So we’re asking you to [**chip in $7**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-october-2025?refcode=em_20251028_5050_fr&amount=7&refcode2=5050_22930333_vKLqMD&akid=5050%2E22930333%2EvKLqMD). Here’s how we’ll put it to work: All over the country, there are millions of people who — for one reason or another — don’t vote in every election. **We use contributions to reach them and persuade them to cast a ballot this year** — by funding more advertising, scaling up our phone-calling and texting efforts, or by expanding our on-the-ground organizing work and ensuring we have enough volunteers to knock on as many doors as possible. Your donation will go towards funding work like this. If we can scale up our voter outreach in these next seven days, we will win close races in states like Virginia, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and beyond. If we don’t have the resources to do that, we could very well come up short. So we’re asking: [**Can you make your first contribution to the DNC today?
